connector_host.description: Connector Host when not using BlueXP.

increase_capacity_size.description: Additional capacity to add to the aggregate (only available during updates)

increase_capacity_unit.description: Unit for the additional capacity (Byte, KB, MB, GB, or TB) (only available during updates)

initial_ev_aggregate_size.description: Initial size for EBS Elastic Volumes aggregate. This enables the aggregate to support capacity expansion.

initial_ev_aggregate_unit.description: Unit for initial EBS Elastic Volumes aggregate size

storage_account_network_access.description: Controls network access for the storage account. Accepted values: Enabled, Disabled, SecuredByPerimeter.

delete_destination_volume.description: Set to true to delete the destination volume when the snapmirror relationship is destroyed

datastore_size_capacity.description: The size of the datastore. Must be equal to the LUN size.

datastore_size_unit.description: The unit of the datastore size: ['Byte', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'].

cluster_name.description: The name of the AVS cluster.

private_cloud_name.description: The name of the AVS private cloud.

resource_group.description: The resource group of the AVS private cloud.

sync_trigger.description: An arbitrary value that, when changed, forces a re-sync of AVS hosts. Change this value (e.g., increment a number or set a new timestamp) to trigger a re-sync without modifying other fields.
